content: Tasolonqen Phawuloosanne Sillaase
Phawuloosinne Sillaasi Anfiphoolanne Apholooniya geetettiza derera aadhdhidi Tasolonqe geetettiza dere bida; heenkka Ayhudata Woosa Keeththi dees.
Phawuloosikka izas lose gidida mala Ayhudata Woosa Keeth gelides; heedzdzu saamintta kumeth qaalappe ekki ekki isttara haasayettides.
Kirstoosi waaye ekkanaassinne hayqqi dendanaas bessizayssa qonccisi ammanththon, «Hayssi ta sabbakiza Yesusi izi kiitetti yaana geetettidayssako!» gides.

Ayhudatappe issi issi asay ba siyidayssa ammanidi Phawuloosaranne Sillaasera issife gidides; qasseka daro derey Xoossas yayyiza Giriketappe daro erettida maccassati ba siyida qaalaan ammanidi isttara issino gidida.

Ayhudati qasse istta qanaatidi giyan diza wordo asata shiishshidi kumeththa dereza istta bolla denththeththidi katamaan shiro medhdhida. Phawuloosanne Sillaase shiishshidi deraa sinththan essanaas issi Iyaasoone geetettizayssaso koyanaas eleli bida.

Gido attiin istta Iyaasoone keeththan demmontta aggida gishshas Iyaasoonenne hara ammaniza asata katama daannata sinththara goochchishe, «Hayti asati dere wursi bul7akishe gam7idi qasse ha7i haa yida.
Iyaasooneykka istta ba keeththan woththides; hayti asati wuri, ‹Yesusa geetettiza hara kawoy dees› giidi Qeesaare woga ekkettenna» gishe waassida.
Dereynne he katamaa daannati hessa siyidi ba giddon buqettida.
Iyaasoonenne haratakka waase xeygisidi yeddida.
Beeriyan Phawuloosanne Sillaase
Ammanizayti heerakka Phawuloosanne Sillaase qammara Beeriya yeddida; isttika hee gakkida mala Ayhudata Woosa Keeththe gelida.
Beeriya asay Tasolonqe asaappe aadhdhidi akeekara diza asa. Gaasoykka hayssi yo7ozi tumeesha? gi giidi Geeshsha Maxaafata qaalaa wontiin wontiin pilggi xeellidi ufayssan ekkides.
Hessa gishshas isttafe daro asay ammanides; qasseka isttara qoodan daroti bonchchettida Girike dere maccassatinne addetikka ammanida.
Tasolonqen diza Ayhuda asati Phawuloosi Xoossa qaalaa Beeriyankka sabbakizayssa erida mala dereza denththeththanaas qasseka isttako bida.
He wode ammanizayti Phawuloosa ellesidi gede abba achchi yeddida; Sillaasinne Ximtoosi heen attida.
Phawuloosa moyzida asati iza Ateena gaththida; qasseka Sillaasinne Ximtoosi izakko eleli gakkana mala giza kiita Phawuloosappe ekkidi simmida.
Ateenan Phawuloosa
Phawuloosi Ateenan istta naagishin Ateena kataman eeqati kumidayssa be7idi daro shenetides.
Hessa gishshas Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan Ayhudataranne Xoossas yayyiza Girike asaara qasseka giyay dizason gallas gallas banara gaaggiza asaara haasayettides.

Efiqoroosenne Isttoyko geetettiza eranchchata bagga gididayti Phawuloosakko shiiqidi izara haasayettida; isttafe issi issi asati, «Hayssi lom7ulom7ay ay gaana koyzee?» gida; baggayti qasse Yesusa gishshassinne hayqoppe iza denththaa mishiraachcho izi sabbakishin siyidi, «Hessi hara ooraththa eeqata gishshas yootiza misatees» gida.
Iza oykkidi Ariyosfaagoose geetettiza dere duulata sinth efidi, «Ha ne tamaarsiza ooraththa timirtey aazakko nu erana mala ne koyay?» gida.
Qasse ne nuna nu hayththan sissiza yo7oy nu erontta oorath gidida gishshas izi aazakko nu erana koyoos.
Ateena asay kumeth qasseka haan diza hara dere asaykka baas wode aaththanaas ooraththa yo7o haasayaninne sissan attiin hara miishshan wode aaththettenna.
Hessa gishshas Phawuloosi Ariyosfaagoose geetettiza duulatan shiiqida dereza sinththan eqqidi, «Hayto Ateena asatoo! Intte beettoo miish ubbaa ammanizayta gididayssa ta beyays.

Ta yaanne haa yuuyishin intte isttas goynniza miishshata ta xeellishin, ‹Erettontta Xoos› geetetti xaafettidayssa issi yarshosoho demmadis; hessa gishshas hessa intte erontta goynnizayssa ta inttena erisana.
Hayssa alamezanne iza giddonkka dizayssa ubbaa medhdhida Xoossi izi salonne sa7a Godaa; hessa gishshas izi asa kushen keexettida keeththan deenna.
Izi as ubbaas de7onne shempo; qasseka hara wursi immizayssa gidida gishshas izas paccizaazi baynda gishshas izi asa kusheppe maado ekkenna.
Asa zereth ubbaa issaadefe medhdhidi asi biitta bolla daana mala ooththides; asay daana wodenne wurseththa dhas woththides.
Hessika asi Xoos koyidinne pilggidi demmanaakko giidi woththides; hessi hessa gidikkoka izi nuuppe issi issaadefe haakki diza gishshas gidenna.
Nu de7o demmiday, dizaynne qaaxettizay izanna; intte deren yeth kessiza issi issi asati, ‹Nunikka iza nayta› gida mala.
«Histtiko nu Xoossa nayta gidikko Xoossi as erateththan medhdhi kessida worqqa woykko bira woykko shuch misatees giidi nu qoppanaas bessenna.
Kasetidi Xoossi hayssa mala hanota asay erontta ooththidayssa dandayan aadhdhides; ha7i gidikko asi wuri ba dizason dizason maaroteththan gelana mala azazees» gides.
Izi ba dosidaade baggara biitta bolla xilloteththan pirdana gallas bare woththides. Izakka hayqoppe denththidi as ubbaas hayssa tumateththa erisides.
Isttika hayqqidayta denththaa gishshas siyida mala issi issi asati iza qidhida; baggayti qasse, «Hayssa qasseka nu neeppe hara gallas siyana koyoos» gida.
Heerakka Phawuloosi istta giddofe kezi bides.
Issi issi asati qasse Phawuloosa kaallidanne ammanida; heytappeka Diyonassiyoosa geetettiza Ariyosfaagoose duulata keeththa Abaale gidida Deemarso geetettiza maccassayanne haratikka issife deettes.
